crossRefs.note: Joshua therefore came to them suddenly. He marched from Gilgal all night.
For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.
For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant…

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

people.name: Merom
people.line: A place where Joshua defeated Jabin's coalition

translations.web: So Joshua came suddenly, with all the warriors, against them by the waters of Merom, and attacked them.
translations.bsb: So by the waters of Merom, Joshua and his whole army came upon them suddenly and attacked them,
